The plate is a square side plate, roughly 24 cm across. The food is a piece of baked salmon with a herb and almond-sliver topping. It spans about 165 px of the plate's roughly 450 px width, which is about 9 cm, and it is roughly 2 cm thick with a width of about 6 cm. That gives a volume of about 9 × 6 × 2 ≈ 108 cm³, but the piece is irregular and tapered, so I'd put it nearer 80 g. Salmon is about 200 kcal/100 g, and I've counted the almond slivers as a separate small item.
